name: Ten e-invoice portals notified from 1 January 2020

attrs.quote: This notification shall come into force with effect from the 1stday of January, 2020.
attrs.note: www.einvoice1.gst.gov.in to www.einvoice10.gst.gov.in, websites managed by the Goods and Services Tax Network, are the Common Goods and Services Tax Electronic Portal for rule 48(4).
